subject: science
passage: The Great Rann of Kutch, in the Indian state of Gujarat, is a flat, low-lying stretch of land near the Arabian Sea. During the monsoon, shallow, salty water floods much of it. When the dry season arrives, the hot sun evaporates this water. ______ a vast white crust of salt is left behind, covering the ground as far as the eye can see.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

explanation.why: The text explains that salty water floods the land and then evaporates in the sun. The last sentence gives what this evaporation produces: a crust of salt. A cause-and-effect transition is needed.
explanation.A: Incorrect. The salt crust is not an example of the water evaporating; it is what the evaporation leaves behind.
explanation.B: Incorrect. "Similarly" signals a parallel idea, but the last sentence describes a result.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The salt crust does not contrast with the evaporation; it follows from it.
explanation.D: Correct. "As a result" shows that the salt crust is left because the salty water evaporates.
